questions.questionText: Which sentence is an empty filler?

options.text: This is a very interesting and controversial topic.
Free museums attract tourists who spend money locally.

explanations.general: Correct answer: This is a very interesting and controversial topic.

questions.questionText: More precise than “bad” in “Smoking is bad for health”?

explanations.general: Correct answer: unnecessary because it repeats something

content.text: Esta frase traz uma ideia nova?

This is a very interesting and controversial topic, and everyone has their own opinion about it. In my personal opinion, I think that online classes are good. There are many advantages and disadvantages. Due to the fact that online classes are flexible, students have the ability to study at any time. This is a very good thing. Also, online classes are good because they are good for people who work. People who work can study at night. In order to conclude, as I said before, online classes are good and I think universities should offer more online classes in the future.

I think universities should offer more online classes. First, they make higher education accessible to people who work full-time: a student with a day job can watch recorded lectures at night. Second, they cut costs for students, who save on transportation and housing near campus. I agree with Ana that online students may feel isolated, but short live group sessions can solve this problem without losing flexibility.
por ideias concretas · acrescentou 1 razão nova e 1 contraponto.

questions.questionText: “In my personal opinion, I believe that students should do sports.” → I ______ students should do sports. (mais conciso)

explanations.general: I believe students should do sports.

questions.questionText: Concise version of “At this point in time, a large number of people use apps in order to learn languages.”

options.text: Many people now use apps to learn languages.
At this point, many people in time use apps.
A large number of people use apps in order to learn languages now.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Many people now use apps to learn languages.

questions.questionText: Why was “In order to conclude, as I said before…” removed?

options.text: It repeats ideas without adding anything.

explanations.B: Não é o motivo (e nem é perfeita).
explanations.general: Correct answer: It repeats ideas without adding anything.

questions.questionText: A longer answer with repeated ideas is always better than a shorter answer with more ideas.

explanations.general: Falso: densidade de ideias importa mais que tamanho.

content.text: Corte frases vazias, encurte expressões, troque palavras vagas e acrescente
Should companies allow employees to work from home permanently?

Working from home is a very interesting topic that a lot of people are discussing nowadays, and there are many different opinions about it. In my personal opinion, I think that companies should allow it. Working from home is good. It is good because people don't need to go to the office. Due to the fact that they don't go to the office, they have the ability to save time. Saving time is a very good thing for everybody. Also, working from home is good for the environment. It is good for the environment because there are fewer cars. Of course, there are also some disadvantages of working from home, like every situation in life has advantages and disadvantages. In order to conclude, as I said before, working from home is good and companies should allow it in the future because it is good.
O aluno lê as duas versões em voz alta. O professor pergunta:
Which version has more ideas? Which is easier to read?

content.text: I think · because · now · Everyone knows… (ou corte).
1 I believe students should do sports. 2 Many people now use apps to learn languages. 3 Every student can improve. 4 The outcome of the experiment was positive. 5 Exercise is healthy.
Many students work, have families or live far from campus. For them, online classes are a practical option. Universities should offer more of these courses.

I think companies should allow employees to work from home permanently, at least for jobs that can be done online. First, employees save time: without a daily commute, they can start work earlier or spend more time with their families. Second, remote work reduces traffic and pollution in big cities. Some managers worry that teams lose contact, but regular video meetings and one office day per month can keep people connected without losing these benefits.
